description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Hungary Hungary 2026 general Monday-Friday work schedule result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when hungary 2026 general Monday-Friday work schedule only (Labour Code section 97(2), NGM 10/2025). Requires explicit work_schedule. Eleven statutory holidays and three paired transfers are included; three Saturdays are working. No shift, personal, bank, exchange, school, local-office opening or payroll schedule is inferred. No automatic substitute Monday. The annual decree expires 2027-01-01; later schedules require new evidence.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2026 authority events. Requires an explicit general Monday-Friday work schedule; includes three working Saturdays and paired rest dates.
Example user requests: Hungary: Working Saturday compensates August 21. | Hungary: Christmas Eve is transferred rest, not statutory holiday. | Hungary: Whit Monday.
Inputs: date (date); work_schedule (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-08-08","work_schedule":"general_monday_friday"} | {"date":"2026-12-24","work_schedule":"general_monday_friday"} | {"date":"2026-05-25","work_schedule":"general_monday_friday"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources, work_schedule, is_statutory_holiday, is_transferred_rest_day, is_makeup_working_day, transfer_pair, payroll_scope.
Formula: working = published makeup day OR (weekday AND not statutory holiday AND not transferred rest)
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/hungary-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/hungary-public-working-day.md

work_schedule.description: Required: confirm the general Monday-Friday work schedule under Labour Code 97(2). Do not use for shifts or institution-specific opening.

name: check_hu_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_makeup_working_day.description: Whether result.date is a published working Saturday.

is_statutory_holiday.description: Whether result.date is a Labour Code 102(1) holiday.

is_transferred_rest_day.description: Whether result.date is one of the three NGM rest dates.

is_working_day.description: General-schedule working date, including the three published makeup Saturdays.

substitute_day_policy.description: Only three published 2026 transfer pairs; no substitute Monday inferred

transfer_pair.description: Paired working/rest dates and legal basis for result.date, otherwise empty object.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Hungary Working Day
